method_path: Find h using roots symmetry or completing square or differentiation
Calculate k by substituting h into f(x)
accepted_alternatives: Use roots and symmetry: h = (-1 + -3)/2 = -2, then k = f(-2) = -5
Expand, differentiate to find vertex x = -2, then k = f(-2) = -5
Expand, use axis of symmetry h = -b/(2a) = -20/(10) = -2, then k = f(-2) = -5

evidence.basis: METHOD 1: a=5 (A1), attempt to use roots and symmetry to find h (M1), h=-2 (A1), f(x)=5(x+2)^2-5 A1. METHOD 2: a=5 (A1), attempt to expand (M1), complete square or differentiate or axis of symmetry (A1), h=-2, f(x)=5(x+2)^2-5 A1.
